source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check if system could power on with 1 PSU connected with power cable. Add PSU one by one and check if system could power on.
2. Boot system to OS with full PSU.
3. Remove power cable and PSU of 1st slot. And check if system is still normal or shutdown.
4. Plug PSU and power cable. Check LED of PSU.
5. Repeat steps 3~4 to all the reset of PSU.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. System should be unable to power on with 2PSU
2. System should not shutdowm when hot-remove one PSU

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Check PSU redundant: power-cycle the system while physically adding/removing PSU power cables and verify it powers on with fewer PSUs and does not shut down on hot-remove. A physical power-cabling manipulation the agent cannot do.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator adds/removes PSU cables, boots the system and confirms it stays up on one PSU and does not shut down on hot-remove; agent cannot touch PSU cables.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED correctly identifies the one-PSU procedure versus unable-with-two-PSU contradiction and requires a corrected population, redundancy and load matrix before any power action.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 806/2291 preserves the physical boundary but repeats the contradictory criterion and does not define supported population, feed topology or safe service state.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Its non-counting sequence-971 draft was inspected only as history; this review independently adds per-population cold-start versus per-slot live-service separation, AC-feed identity, same-module restoration and measurable `normal` host criteria.

original_test_intent: Establish the Project-supported minimum PSU population for cold power-on, then with the full approved population booted, service each supported PSU slot one at a time and prove host continuity, expected PSU indication and complete redundancy recovery. The Master cannot presently define PASS because it asks for one-PSU boot but says two PSUs must be unable to power on.
original_method: Physically connect one PSU and attempt power-on, add PSUs one by one while checking power-on, boot the full population to OS, then disconnect the cable and remove each module, observe whether the host remains normal or shuts down, restore the same module/feed and inspect its LED.
manual_activity: Only after correction, a qualified operator configures the approved PSU/cable population before cold-start attempts, then de-energizes or disconnects and removes one supported module at a time in the exact vendor sequence, observes physical LEDs/connectors and restores the same module/feed. Automation may collect read-only power, BMC, SEL and host-continuity evidence.
required_inputs: Engineer-corrected matrix for zero, one, two and full fitted PSU populations, including supported/unsupported cold power-on, boot completion and any load/configuration dependency
Clarification whether `add PSU one by one` means power-off population changes followed by separate cold starts or supported live insertion
Per-PSU physical slot, serial, model/firmware, rated/derated capacity, AC feed/group, cable/PDU outlet, LED states and BMC/PMBus/SEL identity
N+M or other redundancy policy, current and test maximum demand, remaining-feed/module capacity, load-share/failover tolerance and host continuity definition
Vendor hot-plug/removal order, cable-before-module or module-before-cable requirement, connector safety, operator authorization, abort, same-module reinsertion and recovery criteria
safety_requirements: Do not connect, disconnect or remove any PSU until engineers correct the one-versus-two-PSU acceptance and approve each population/service state.
Do not infer that a redundant label guarantees reduced-population boot or hot removal at the current load; prove remaining module and AC-feed capacity with Project margin.

Bind every physical slot to module serial and AC feed/PDU outlet, and follow the vendor's exact de-energize, cable, latch, insertion and re-energize order; do not touch exposed contacts or use damaged connectors.
Separate cold-start population trials from live one-module service. Never add or remove a module live unless that exact chassis/PSU combination supports it.
Export SEL/BMC/host/power baselines before any approved clear; preserve first failure and do not automatically retry power-on or removal.

Continuously monitor input/output power, load sharing, remaining PSU derating, feed state, rails, temperatures, fans, BMC and host continuity; abort on overload, arcing, connector heating, rail instability, unexpected shutdown or management loss.
Restore the same module and feed, secure latches/cables, verify FRU/status/LED/power/load sharing and regain full redundancy before another slot or population.
agent_execution_scope: Before correction, perform no power, PSU, cable, BMC-control or log-clear action and record only the source conflict and required decision.

After approval, collect inventory and capacity baselines, timestamp engineer actions, and capture per-population power-on/boot results plus per-slot live power, PMBus, BMC/SEL and host-continuity evidence.
Report cold-start support, live failover and restoration as distinct checkpoints; define host `normal` through approved boot marker, workload/heartbeat, rails and error/event expectations.
Do not touch cabling/modules, control power, infer minimum count, claim physical LED/connector observations, retry or issue DUT PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Correct Criterion 1 and define the authoritative minimum-population plus cold-start/hot-service matrix in the Review layer while preserving Master.
Approve topology, load/capacity, physical sequence, operator, monitoring, stop and recovery; perform or supervise every cable/module action and LED check.
Verify full population, feed and load-share restoration and issue per-population, per-slot and overall DUT verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its manual physical boundary is correct, but its prose command assumes the very reduced-population behavior that the Master contradicts and lacks a safe slot/feed/load sequence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No physical execution until engineer correction. Afterwards use the approved operator PSU/cable matrix with read-only BMC/PMBus/PDU and host telemetry; no agent-issued power command is required by the source.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: One-PSU connection, add-one-by-one wording, full-population OS boot, cable-plus-module removal for every remaining PSU, LED check, the unable-with-two-PSU criterion, no Script and 5/10-minute estimates remain unmodified.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correct the population matrix; perform separate cold-start trials with power off between approved populations; restore full redundancy; under measured load service one mapped supported PSU at a time; correlate failover/host/LED/events; restore the same module/feed and prove full load sharing before continuing.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Engineer-corrected PSU population, slot/feed topology, rated/derated capacity, redundancy policy and hot-service capability.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/backplane, PSU model/serial/firmware, BMC/PMBus/CPLD and monitoring-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor minimum PSU population, redundancy/load-share, AC-feed and hot-plug/service/connector/LED specification plus Project power budget.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Does not overwrite Master; it resolves cold-start versus live-service phases, binds every action to slot/feed/serial/load and requires complete restoration evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Testing only full-population hot removal does not cover reduced-population cold boot; powered-down module replacement does not prove live failover. Any Project restriction must state the unverified original obligation.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Engineer population decision, topology/capacity, service SOP, Expected Values and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A topology can have adequate total wattage but overload one feed or remaining module after the wrong slot is removed.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may define a configuration-dependent minimum count or prohibit live removal, but must preserve the contradictory source wording, record the exact tested population/load/service state and disclose any cold-start or live-failover coverage not executed.
expected_evidence: Preserved Master conflict plus dated engineer decision for minimum population, cold-start and live-service semantics
PSU slot/serial/model/firmware/rating/derating/AC-feed/PDU/LED/BMC/PMBus map and approved redundancy/load budget
Per-population pre-power configuration, cold-start attempt, power/POST/boot outcome and expected unsupported-state behavior
Full-population baseline and per-slot cable/module action timeline with remaining capacity, rails, load sharing, temperatures/fans, BMC/SEL and host continuity
Per-slot physical LED/connector evidence, same-module/feed restoration, FRU/status/power/load-share recovery and unexpected-event review
All modules/cables secured, full redundancy restored and engineer-owned per-population/per-slot/overall verdicts

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure requires checking power-on with one PSU and adding PSUs one by one, while Criterion 1 requires the system to be unable to power on with two PSUs. Without an explicitly unusual configuration rule, success for the procedure contradicts success for the criterion; the row also leaves cold add versus live add ambiguous.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Minimum viable PSU population and expected boot behavior are core acceptance semantics, not ordinary missing parameters. Choosing either interpretation would intentionally violate the preserved other statement and could subject the remaining power path to an unsafe load, so execution must wait for engineer correction.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes NO/manual-only to a semantic BLOCKED result: its physical boundary is correct, but it cannot authorize an acceptance matrix that contradicts the Master.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on BLOCKED and adds distinct cold-start versus live-service phases, exact feed/serial identity and measurable full-redundancy recovery.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces its physical-only classification with the required source correction and power-capacity gates.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Keeps the block while adding clarification of add-one-by-one state, connector order and per-feed rather than aggregate capacity.

review_improvement: Prevents contradictory minimum-population logic from driving hazardous power manipulation and makes every cold-start, live failover and restoration claim independently auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: If the same configuration is expected to power on with one PSU, a blanket requirement that two PSUs cannot power on reverses the redundancy claim unless an unstated topology rule exists. Because this determines both PASS and whether physical service is safe, AI cannot repair it through a guessed Project value; engineers must correct the acceptance matrix first.
